agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Four Pokémon fainted, but the terminal party retained full-HP Croakatoa and 18-HP Bugatti; every forced replacement followed verified progress.

At action 15 Croakatoa could attack Dustox instead of pivoting, but the one bounded Mud Shot replay triggered Infestation and trapped Croakatoa, so it did not lexicographically dominate the winning Birdlaw line.
The fight used 24 decisions; no slower action is proven avoidable without weakening reserve preservation.

correct_choices: Only Ohmnomnom to Lildozer and Croakatoa to Birdlaw were voluntary switches; both replacements attacked before leaving play.
No Pokémon switched in and immediately switched back out.
Repeated Bulldoze replaced the invalid burned-Lildozer veto.
Bushtank was preserved through Eelektrik and was never spent on Sunflora.
The policy adapted to Dustox appearing before Sunflora and still won with two survivors.
agent_review.next_test: Run unchanged corrected-bundle Clone 2 from the identical opening and repeat the no-switch-spam and reserve-preservation audit.
